A triple T={a,b,c} has a fold of its earlier-link flag graph by domination with singleton a; the reduced link is clique complex of line graph K3 * I_{a+1}, homotopy wedge^{a+1}S². Earlier complex is 2-connected, so cones contribute a+1 S³; the rank sum is C(n+1,4). For each 3-support S, coordinate projection retracts the full cube K_S≈S³ and makes independent oriented 3-set classes yielding ∧³Q^n. Complete S4 signed Lefschetz calculation on 316 nonempty simplices of K4 (317 including empty) gives H3 class traces (5,-3,1,2,-1), minus ∧³ traces (4,-2,0,1,0) equals S4 sign. Projections to distinct four-support subcomplexes then prove quotient ∧⁴Q^n; rational Maschke semisimplicity splits. Independent exact enumerator reproduced character for all 6/24/120 coordinate permutations at n=3/4/5, including empty-face convention; finite checks corroborate, not prove, the uniform attachment and projection steps.
